# iliad-093 — new renderings (15.184–280)

Built on the table's existing rows; the whole-line combinations and the epithets below are new and may recur.

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τὴν δὲ μέγ’ ὀχθήσας προσέφη κλυτὸς ἐννοσίγαιος (15.184, whole-line speech introduction) | "Her, greatly vexed, addressed the famous earth-shaker:" | "Greatly troubled, the famous earth-shaker said to her:" | built on 1.517 (ὀχθήσας, προσέφη) and the table's κλυτὸς ἐννοσίγαιος (8.440); Poseidon is not named |
| τὸν δ’ ἠμείβετ’ ἔπειτα ποδήνεμος ὠκέα Ἶρις (15.200, whole-line reply formula) | "Him then answered wind-footed, swift Iris:" | "Then Iris, wind-footed and swift, answered him:" | "swift-footed"; the table's ποδήνεμος ὠκέα Ἶρις (5.368, 11.195) in the 1.172 reply pattern |
| τὴν δ’ αὖτε προσέειπε Ποσειδάων ἐνοσίχθων (15.205, whole-line reply formula) | "Her then in turn addressed Poseidon earth-shaker:" | "Then Poseidon earth-shaker spoke to her in turn:" | the Odyssey's masculine line (8.354) with "Her" / "to her" |
| καὶ τότ’ Ἀπόλλωνα προσέφη νεφεληγερέτα Ζεύς (15.220, whole-line speech introduction) | "And then Apollo addressed cloud-gatherer Zeus:" | "Then Zeus who gathers the clouds spoke to Apollo:" | "said to Apollo" alone; the table's νεφεληγερέτα Ζεύς pattern (1.517, 5.888, 8.38) |
| ὣς ἔφατ’, οὐδ’ ἄρα πατρὸς ἀνηκούστησεν Ἀπόλλων (15.236, whole line; ἀνηκουστέω "not to listen", from ἀνήκουστος) | "So he spoke, and not at all did Apollo fail to listen to his father," | "So he spoke, and Apollo did not fail to listen to his father," | "did not disobey" (reserved for οὐδ’ ἀπίθησε), "heed"; a different verb from the table's ὣς ἔφατ’, οὐδ’ ἀπίθησε |
| ἀγχοῦ δ’ ἱστάμενος προσέφη ἑκάεργος Ἀπόλλων (15.243, whole-line speech introduction) | "And standing close by addressed far-working Apollo:" | "Standing close beside him, Apollo, who works from afar, spoke to him:" | "far-shooting" (ἑκηβόλος); joins the table's ἀγχοῦ δ’ ἱστάμενος προσέφη (13.768) to ἑκάεργος "far-working" / "who works from afar" |
| τὸν δ’ ὀλιγοδρανέων προσέφη κορυθαίολος Ἕκτωρ (15.246, whole-line reply formula) | "Him, weak, addressed Hector of the glancing helmet:" | "Weak as he was, Hector of the glancing helmet said to him:" | "faint" (kept for ὀλιγηπελέων, 15.245, so the two near-synonyms stay apart); the table's κορυθαίολος (2.816) |
| τὸν δ’ αὖτε προσέειπεν ἄναξ ἑκάεργος Ἀπόλλων (15.253, whole-line reply formula) | "Him then in turn addressed lord far-working Apollo:" | "Then lord Apollo, who works from afar, spoke to him in turn:" | the 15.205 pattern with ἄναξ "lord" and ἑκάεργος "far-working" |
| ὀλιγοδρανέων (15.246; ὀλίγος "little", sense "feeble") | "weak" | "weak" | "faint" (reserved for ὀλιγηπελέων), "feeble", "powerless" |
| ὑπέροπλον (ἔειπεν, 15.185; exact sense not certain) | "presumptuously" | "presumptuously" (+ note: sense not certain) | "overbearing" (kept for ὑπερηνορέων), "overweening" (ὑπερφίαλος), "arrogant" |
| ἰσόμορον (15.209; ἴσος + μοῖρα) | "equal in share" | "who has an equal share" | "of equal fate", "equal in lot" |
| ἀνήκεστος (χόλος, 15.217; ἀκέομαι "heal" with the negative prefix) | "unhealable" | "past healing" | "incurable", "implacable", "unappeasable" |
| χρυσάορον (Φοῖβον Ἀπόλλωνα, 15.256; ἄορ "sword", sense of the compound not certain) | "of the golden sword" | "of the golden sword" (+ note: sense not certain) | "golden-sworded", "of the golden blade", "of the golden bow" |
| φασσοφόνος (ἴρηξ, 15.238; φάσσα "dove" + φόνος) | "dove-slaying" | "a killer of doves" | "dove-killer", "pigeon-killing" |
| ἠϋγένειος (λὶς ἠϋγένειος, 15.275; ἠΰς "fine" + γένειον "beard") | "fine-bearded" | "fine-bearded" | "full-bearded", "bearded"; keeps the table's ἠΰκομος "fine-haired" |
| λίς (15.275, poetic "lion") | "lion" | "lion" | "lioness"; told apart from λέων only by the note |
| ἠλίβατος (15.273) | "towering" | "towering" | follows the Odyssey table (9.243), unchanged |
| ἀνιδρωτί (15.228; ἱδρώς "sweat" with the negative prefix) | "without sweat" | "without sweat" | "without toil", "without a struggle" |
| ἀμφὶς ἐόντες (Κρόνον, 15.225) | "being about Cronus" | "around Cronus" | "on both sides of Cronus", "apart from Cronus" |
